title: Does Massage With or Without Aromatherapy Reduce Infant's Distress?
brief_summary: This study aims to determine the effect of massage with or without aromatherapy on infant´s level of distress
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants aged 6 to 36 months admitted to the Intensive Care-Sophia after craniofacial surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neurological impairment
* Eczema or other skin disorders
* Nut allergy
